components.name: Primary WhatsApp CTA Button
components.description: Main conversion CTA using Rosa Acolhimento (#E9A4A8) and high-contrast Chumbo Suave (#2B2628).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; padding: 0.875rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #E9A4A8; color: #2B2628; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(233, 164, 168, 0.42); transition: transform 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #DF8D92; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2B2628; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.875rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #2B2628; border: 2px solid #E9A4A8; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #FBF0F1; transform: translateY(-2px); }

narrative.northStar: O Consultório Acolhedor em Giz Pastel (The Pastel Crayon Sanctuary)
narrative.overview: The visual system of Ingrid Cunha — Psicóloga Infantojuvenil (CRP 13/12719) balances the emotional warmth and playfulness of childhood development with the clarity, ethics, and scientific rigor that parents expect from a clinical psychologist working with Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (TCC) and Neuropsychology.
keyCharacteristics: Luminous pastel surfaces grounded by warm cream (#FDF9F3) and pure white (#FFFFFF) breathing room.
High-contrast soft charcoal typography (#2B2628) over pastel surfaces to achieve WCAG AAA readability.
Hand-drawn crayon/dry-brush graphical accents used as purposeful focal anchors.
Generously rounded containers (1.25rem to 2.5rem) echoing a safe, child-friendly environment.

rules.name: The Charcoal-On-Pastel Rule
rules.body: Never place pure white body text or button labels directly over #E9A4A8, #F6DEBC, or #BAE5ED; always pair pastel fills with Chumbo Suave (#2B2628) so every button and badge passes WCAG AA/AAA effortlessly.

rules.name: The Official Palette Rule
rules.body: Never introduce external saturated greens, blues, or purples; all conversion CTAs stay strictly within the brand's Rosa Acolhimento (#E9A4A8) and official palette.

dos: Do use only the official palette (#E9A4A8, #F6DEBC, #BAE5ED, #FFFFFF) and its documented warm-cream/charcoal support tokens defined in :root.
Do pair pastel backgrounds with Chumbo Suave (#2B2628) text to maintain WCAG AA/AAA contrast.
Do use the real brand assets (assets/logo.png, assets/ingrid.png, assets/coracao.png, assets/canecas-2.png, assets/icons/insta.png) with explicit width and height attributes.
Do route every WhatsApp CTA through .js-whatsapp-link and WHATSAPP_CONFIG in js/main.js.
donts: Don't invent unrequested accent colors (such as neon WhatsApp greens or generic corporate blues).
Don't use sharp 0px corners or heavy dark brutalist shadows.
Don't include diagnostic checklists, promises of cure, patient testimonials, or identifiable photos of real children.
